title: xml2rel mapping
description: Schema for the YAML mapping consumed by xml2rel. YAML 1.1 values are loaded with a safe loader. Runtime normalization accepts case-insensitive enum values and resolves relative paths against the mapping file.

file.description: Path to the XML input. Relative paths resolve against the mapping file's directory.

batch_size.description: Records buffered per table before a batch write.

error_policy.description: Conversion failure behavior. Input is normalized case-insensitively.

output.description: DuckDB output path, relative to the mapping file when not absolute. The CLI --output option overrides it.

tables.description: Ordered map of output table name to table definition.

source.description: XPath selecting record elements. Supports absolute/relative location paths with /, //, *, element names, and attribute predicates in the MVP.

columns.description: Ordered map of output column name to column definition; declaration order is output column order.

xpath.description: One XPath or an ordered list of XPath expressions, all evaluated relative to the current record element.

strategy.description: How multiple expressions/results are combined. Input is normalized case-insensitively.

type.description: Explicit output type. Input is normalized case-insensitively.
